name: Escalator Outfit Change AI: A New Look With Every Ride
blurb: The escalator outfit change is the fashion clip filmed from straight above a long escalator: you lounge on the moving steps, ride down through the frame, and come back in a new outfit each time.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: genjutsu-motion, 13 s, 480p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text: Replace the young woman with long straight black hair who sits and lounges on the moving escalator steps with the person from image 1: keep that face, hair and skin tone exactly, in every outfit, also when two looks are on screen at once. Take only the face, hair and skin tone from image 1, never the clothes: in every shot the person wears the outfit of the video. Keep every outfit, every new look that rides in from the top of the frame, the escalator, the steel side panels, the light, the motion and the camera of the video.
